extraFacts.fact: Marine hose terms: SAE J2006 R1 is soft-wall and R2 hard-wall (steel helix) wet exhaust hose; Type A1 and A2 are marine fuel hose classes (A1 for fuel lines, A2 for fill and vent); B1 is low-permeation outboard fuel hose; ID is the inside diameter; wet exhaust hose carries engine exhaust and cooling water; bilge hose handles bilge water, and live-well hose carries water to a fishing live well.
extraFacts.source: SAE J2006; SAE J1527; ISO 8469; ABYC H-24 (hose standards for marine exhaust and fuel)
